repository_recommendation.layout: single repository with small explicit tracks

tracks.purpose: Allocation, process termination, environment variables, sorting/searching helpers, and common stdlib extensions.
Raw byte memory operations and the difference between object bytes and strings.
NUL-terminated byte strings, comparisons, searching, collation, and common string extensions.
Character classification, case mapping, locale-sensitive predicates, and signed-char pitfalls.
Wide string copying, comparison, searching, transformation, and wide-memory operations.
Wide-character I/O, multibyte conversion state, numeric conversion, and locale-sensitive text boundaries.
Wide character classification, mapping, and locale-aware wide-character predicates.
Opening, closing, positioning, reading, writing, renaming, temporary files, and stream ownership.
printf/scanf families, varargs wrappers, format checking, and formatted conversion hazards.
Character/line I/O, pushback, EOF/error state, flushing, and buffering mode.
Integer parsing, inttypes helpers, option parsing, and defensive conversion practice.
Trigonometric and hyperbolic math families, including float/double/long double variants.
Exponentials, logarithms, roots, powers, and gamma/error-function families.
Rounding, remainder, scaling, decomposition, and integer-result math APIs.
Floating-point environment, NaN/nextafter/fma/min/max style helpers, and numerical edge cases.
Complex absolute value, phase, real/imaginary access, conjugation, and projection helpers.
Complex trigonometric and hyperbolic function families.
Complex exponentials, logarithms, powers, and square roots.
Time, locale, atomics, setjmp/signal-style control flow, and their common extensions.
File descriptors, open/read/write/close, vectored I/O, short reads/writes, async I/O, descriptor ownership, and cleanup.
Paths, permissions, stat, links, directories-as-filesystem-objects, timestamps, and filesystem mutation.
Directory traversal, glob/fnmatch/wordexp, path decomposition, and tree walking.
fork, exec, wait, spawn, signals, inherited resources, CLOEXEC, and process failure paths.
Thread creation, joining, detaching, identity, scheduling hooks, and basic lifecycle ownership.
Mutexes, condition variables, read/write locks, and synchronization cleanup rules.
Thread-local storage, once initialization, cancellation state, cancellation points, and cleanup hazards.
POSIX and XSI IPC: message queues, semaphores, shared memory, keys, readiness, cleanup, and permissions.
socket, bind, listen, accept, connect, socketpair, shutdown, socket options, and socket metadata.
send/recv families, byte order, inet conversion, and network address helper functions.
getaddrinfo/getnameinfo, protocol/service databases, interface enumeration, and Ethernet helpers.
Resolver state, DNS message parsing/packing, compressed names, and resolver validation helpers.
Terminal control, user/group lookup, identity APIs, tty databases, utmpx records, and interactive program boundaries.
Resource limits, priorities, clocks/time, memory mapping/locking, host/system configuration, and portable platform administration APIs.
syslog, err/warn-style diagnostics, formatted messages, and teachable logging/error-reporting practice.
Dynamic loading, regex, iconv, locale/message catalogs, legacy DBM, and libc search structures.
Error objects, errno mapping, assertions/check helpers, reporting, and failure-aware control flow.
Creating, configuring, labeling, duplicating, and destroying p101 environments.
Resource events, call tracing, fault injection, event-log formatting, and observer configuration.
Finite-state-machine structure, state transitions, callbacks, invalid transitions, and lifecycle ownership.
C facts, small analyzers, and writing tools that reason about p101 projects.
